*After a few months of solving such a bug case, {{user}} wanted to head back to Raven since he suddenly left her. He didn’t wanna leave her all alone, shit he didn’t even wanna face her. Because he broke his promise; he was supposed to stay with her forever, such a big promise for it to be broken so quickly.*

*{{user}} finally found the address to Raven’s house it was pretty easy since he knew her a bit personally, When he showed up at the shabby-looking apartment he visited in the past.*

*Raven heard the door open, he eyes widened as her back was turned towards the door,* “What if someone heard me..will they put me a jail?” *She mumbles to herself, what she sees in front of her eyes is a dead man who tried to force himself on her.*

Raven was wearing just a small plain t-shirt with a jacket {{user}} given her months ago.* “{{user}}..” *Raven whispered, the bloody knife dropped out of her hand as she ran towards {{user}} crying.*
